project_context.target_audience: Patients seeking holistic care (Modern & Traditional) and Practitioners
project_context.theme_strategy: Organic & Earthy (Archetype 1) with Modern Tech accents

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Adds authority and warmth.

body.usage: Use for all UI text, paragraphs, and data.

primary.name: Deep Forest
primary.usage: Primary Buttons, Active States, Brand Headers

buttons.primary: bg-green-900 text-white hover:bg-green-800 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-all shadow-lg hover:shadow-green-900/20
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-stone-900 border border-stone-200 hover:border-stone-300 hover:bg-stone-50 rounded-full px-6 py-4 transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-stone-600 hover:text-green-900 hover:bg-green-50 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.doctor_profile: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-100 p-6 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 group
cards.feature: bg-stone-100/50 rounded-3xl p-8 hover:bg-white hover:shadow-md transition-all border border-transparent hover:border-stone-100

inputs.default: bg-white border-stone-200 focus:border-green-800 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-green-800 rounded-lg h-12 px-4
inputs.search: bg-white shadow-sm border-stone-200 rounded-full h-14 px-6 text-lg

navigation.wrapper: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-100

marketing.hero: Asymmetric split: Text left (60%), Image collage right (40%) with floating elements
marketing.features: Zig-zag layout with large generous whitespace

dashboard.sidebar: Fixed left, dark green or light stone
dashboard.widgets: White cards with soft shadows, dense data but readable type

assets.icons: Use Lucide React (default). For specialized medical icons, use Phosphor Icons if needed.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text on Green-900 is White. Text on Stone-50 is Stone-900.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Organic & Earthy' theme strictly. Do not revert to standard SaaS blue.
Use the provided image URLs for doctor profiles to create realistic demos.
Ensure the distinction between 'Modern' and 'Traditional' is visual but respectful (e.g., Iconography: Stethoscope vs. Leaf/Mortar).
For the Dashboard, prioritize clarity. Use the 'High Density Grid' rules.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings. Import 'Merriweather' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
